sources_changed: S09: The standard prEN 18229-1 has progressed to the public enquiry stage. According to the JTC 21 official website, the public hearing (enquiry) for prEN 18229-1 was scheduled until 20 August 2026.

S10: The standard prEN 18282 has progressed to Public Enquiry stage. According to the official JTC 21 website dated May 8, 2026, EN 18282 (Cybersecurity specifications for AI systems) is now available for Public Enquiry, marking a stage advancement from the previously recorded draft status with no specified stage.

S11: prEN 18228 entered public enquiry phase in May 2026, with the enquiry period running until 30 July 2026. The CEN-CENELEC official news page confirms the standard is under Public Enquiry to support Article 9 of the AI Act.
S14: The EDPB Opinion 28/2024 on AI models was formally adopted on 17 December 2024 and published on 18 December 2024. The stage changed from none to 'Adopted'.

S25: The three standards are confirmed to remain in draft status (prEN) but are now at different stages: prEN 18287 is Under Enquiry, prEN 18281 is Under Approval, and prEN 18285 is Under Drafting. These stages were not previously recorded.
summary: Five sources advanced this round. Three harmonised standards for AI systems moved to public enquiry: prEN 18229-1 (enquiry closed August 2026), prEN 18282 on cybersecurity specifications (enquiry opened May 2026), and prEN 18228 (enquiry until July 2026). The EDPB Opinion 28/2024 on AI models was formally adopted in December 2024. Three additional standards under source S25 progressed to distinct stages: prEN 18287 is under enquiry, prEN 18281 under approval, and prEN 18285 under drafting. Two proposed changes (S20 and S35) were rejected. No rows await owner decision. Evidence is missing or outdated for twenty-four rows spanning risk management, GDPR obligations, data governance, and transparency requirements. Two rows have current evidence on file. No evidence checks failed due to configuration or system errors.
